title: Kalshi wants 24/7 Tesla and Nvidia perps as Wall Street fights over who regulates them
summary: The prediction-market operator plans to seek U.S. approval for about 60 stock and ETF perps, taking one of crypto's biggest trading products into equities.

title: India starts tokenizing $620 billion corporate bond market with digital rupee settlement
summary: SEBI’s Demat 2.0 pilot turns corporate bonds into digital tokens and settles payment through the RBI’s wholesale digital rupee, with secondary trading and retail access expected in later phases.

title: Bitcoin below $77,000, Zcash leads losses as traders bet on a Fed rate hike
summary: Ninety-five of the CoinDesk 100 fell over the past 24 hours, and bitcoin has shed more than 5% on the week.

title: Ripple puts AI agents inside its $1 billion corporate treasury bet
summary: The software can monitor cash, risk and forecasts and suggest financial moves, but humans still have to approve every action.

title: New Clarity Act text tweaks DeFi, credit union provisions, but road ahead for bill remains murky
summary: The Clarity Act needs 60 votes when the Senate returns from its recess next week. Republicans circulated a fresh draft on Thursday ahead of the vote.
